title: Large personal Atari ST and DOS matching-source/game recovery discovery
summary: Personally screen 569 candidate URLs and add 25 projects, with four explicit non-promotion decisions.
notes: Root assistant personally screened targeted-platform and source-port sections of a current discovery index, then reviewed 29 original repositories and implementation files. This pass adds 25 records and 4 explicit platform-scope deferrals. Search-list PC/DOS labels are not accepted as platform proof: Windows Fallout/Heroes and PowerPC Warlords are separated. Source mirrors credit the original reconstruction author; exactness claims distinguish function splicing, original-byte retention, compiler differences and incomplete semantic annotation. Script bytecode and EGA/data-memory adapters are distinguished from CPU execution. No candidate build, downloaded binary, patch installer or game was executed. Large or encoding-mismatched evidence remains immutable-linked.

sources.reason: Reko project preserves real-mode entry points, named globals/types and image/map format findings for BattleTech Crescent Hawks Inception.
Recovered x86 assembly game is connected to C++ SDL services and game-specific fixes for unfinished Bedlam 2.
Recovered game routines retain their function-level boundaries while portable C raster and host services replace DOS hardware-facing operations.
Reconstructs Blood engine and MAPEDIT across shareware, registered, Plasma Pak and 3DFX variants, with version-specific source/build selection.
C game/episode modules and SDL platform code reconstruct Commander Keen Vorticons 1–3 with accuracy-oriented behavior and multiple host ports.
Mirrors K1n9_Duk3’s reconstruction for EGA/CGA Keen 4–6 releases, using related released id-engine sources to recover original layout and game routines.
Adapts reconstructed Keen 4 source for Tandy 16-color display/music, with MCGA/EGA/CGA variants and ZX0 compression to fit 720 KiB media.
Builds Scott Smitelli’s recovered Cosmore source against portable DOS service and EGA interfaces, retaining game logic while adapting rendering/audio.
Reprograms SSI Gold Box game in C# with recovered data structures, typed offset serialization and game logic.
Documents executable/data investigation and implements HUFF decompression, EGA image conversion, map rendering and level editor for Haunted Mansion.
Preserves separate PC-DOS and PC-9821 recovery lineages, unified SKWINSPX work and graphics/dungeon editors with explicit semantic renaming history.
Recovers game C units and XnGine assembly with original compiler matching, plus separately investigated readable-engine and modern-port work.
Implements DOS loader, relocatable patch payload and installer to bring selected Windows-era Fallout engine fixes to DOS executable.
Restores readable names/comments in DEACC-recovered Hexen level scripts and checks recompilation against BEHAVIOR bytecode lumps.
Organizes recovered room/global scripts from Lucasfilm and Humongous titles using descumm and later NUTcracker.
Source implements executable-version checks, overlay preparation and assembly patches to Transport Tycoon Deluxe internals with recovered structure documentation.
Raw overlay decompilation and progressively annotated C replace addresses with game structs/constants while preserving uncovered unknowns.
Reconstructs GAME.EXE through original compiler comparison, with OSI assembly support and segmented C source ordering.
NASM code and Java patcher modify recovered input/UI routines and handle segment-reference relocation metadata across four Ultima executables.
Documents and decodes portraits, monsters, maps, fonts, messages, sounds and character records; includes working-source picture and roster editors.
Annotated procedures and IDA-export material explain ZZT creature behavior, structures and tick routines.
Extends faithful test-drive-sdl3 C core with high-resolution road rendering, longer draw distance and smooth presentation while retaining original simulation.
Reimplements TD2EGA game core with original data/memory organization and adds modern rendering, launchers and map viewer.
Ports reconstructed Vorticons, Omnispeak-derived Galaxy and released Keen Dreams logic into Godot, with classic/enhanced modes and content editors.
Christophe Fontanel reconstruction covers multiple DM/CSB versions with named C, inline 68000 performance routines, boot/load/decompression paths and protection analysis.
README explicitly targets Windows/x86 and says original DOS port is out of scope. Relevant reconstruction but not a DOS restoration for this focused pass.
Default target is Buka 2003 Windows build, with Win95 version lineage and VC6 toolchain. Do not classify it as DOS merely because the original title also shipped for DOS.
Default target is Windows Heroes II Gold Buka 2003 with Visual C++ 6, not the DOS executable. Retain for a later Windows-specific pass.
README identifies PowerPC Mac reconstruction and InfiniteMac comparisons; not DOS Warlords II despite discovery-list grouping.
